title: NEURON: A Neuro-symbolic System for Grounded Clinical Explainability
abstract: arXiv:2605.01189v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Clinical AI adoption is hindered by the black-box/grey-box nature of high-performing models, which lack the ontological grounding and narrative transparency required for professional-level explainability. We present NEURON, a neuro-symbolic system designed to enhance both predictive reliability and clinical interpretability. NEURON integrates SNOMED CT ontology-informed structural representations with machine learning models to bridge the gap between raw data and medical nomenclature. translated_title: NEURON：一个用于基于临床可解释性的神经符号系统
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.01189v3 公告类型：替换  摘要：临床AI的采用受到高性能模型黑盒/灰盒特性的阻碍，这些模型缺乏专业级可解释性所需的本体论基础和叙事透明度。我们提出了NEURON，一个旨在增强预测可靠性和临床可解释性的神经符号系统。NEURON将SNOMED CT本体论信息结构表示与机器学习模型集成，以弥合原始数据和医学术语之间的差距。为了促进与人类对齐的交互，该系统利用基于检索增强生成（RAG）的接地大语言模型（LLM）层，将SHAP特征归因和患者特定临床笔记合成为连贯的自然语言解释。在MIMIC-IV数据集上对急性心力衰竭死亡率预测进行验证，NEURON将AUC从0.71-0.74提高到0.74-0.77，并在人类评估中显著优于基于SHAP的解释。
tldr: NEURON通过结合SNOMED CT本体论和RAG接地的大语言模型，显著提升了急性心力衰竭死亡率预测的准确性和临床可解释性。
en_tdlr: NEURON integrates SNOMED CT ontology and RAG-grounded LLM to improve both predictive accuracy and clinical interpretability for acute heart failure mortality prediction.
